findings.evidence: Hom.lean:68 `lemma Hom.toOverHom_id`, :73 `lemma Hom.toOverHom_comp`, :91 `lemma Hom.toOverHom_mk'`, :128 `lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_mk'` — all namespaced `Hom`; Trivial.lean:90 `lemma toOverHom_toTrivial` is the only `toOverHom_*` lemma in the repo outside `Hom`.
findings.fix: Rename to `Hom.toOverHom_toTrivial` (declare it as `lemma Hom.toOverHom_toTrivial`), matching `Hom.toOverHom_id`, `Hom.toOverHom_comp`, `Hom.toOverHom_mk'`.
findings.issue: `toOverHom_toTrivial` is declared in `namespace AbelianVariety`, so its full name is `AbelianVariety.toOverHom_toTrivial`, while every other lemma about `Hom.toOverHom` lives in `AbelianVariety.Hom`. It breaks the `Hom.toOverHom_*` family and is not found by dot/tab completion on `Hom.toOverHom_`.

findings.evidence: naming-conventions.md, "Identifiers and theorem names": "the name of theorem simply describes the conclusion", cf. `le_iff_lt_or_eq`, `sub_add_eq_add_sub`; Trivial.lean:96-99 statement is `(m : A ⟶ trivial K) : m = toTrivial A`.
findings.issue: `hom_toTrivial_eq` does not read from its conclusion. The conclusion is `m = toTrivial A`, so by the convention (name describes the conclusion, read outward) the name should lead with `eq`; `hom_toTrivial_eq` reads as a description of the hypothesis with a trailing statement-shape tag.

summary: Names are otherwise consistent with adjacent declarations (`baseChange_dim`/`baseChange_toScheme`) and Mathlib precedent (`isTerminalPUnit`, `continuous_id`), and no notation is added. One lemma is declared outside the namespace its whole family lives in.
